subject: TekLink: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — KMS & HSM artifacts and rotation details
messages:
From: Amira Qureshi <amira@teklink.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Mar 10, 2026 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: TekLink: SIG / CAIQ follow-up - KMS & HSM artifacts

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks again for the walkthrough today. TekLink is progressing through our SIG/CAIQ review; a few of our security reviewers asked for concrete artifacts around encryption and key management so we can close the relevant control cards. Specifically we need the following (ideally as redacted samples where appropriate):

- HSM attestation or vendor statement of conformity (latest year)
- Sample key rotation logs for customer tenant keys for the last 6 months (include timestamps, operator id, and rotation event type)
- Operator access matrix / operator role mapping for HSM/KMS (who can unseal, who can rotate)
- TLS/transit encryption configuration snippet showing cipher suites and cert rotation cadence for edge-to-runtime connections

We're treating this as a high-priority gating item for our procurement/compliance team. If you can provide a redacted bundle by EOD Friday (Mar 12), that would keep us on track. If any of these items are problematic to share, please indicate what we can accept instead (e.g., attestation + from-vendor CSP report) and we'll log a question with our auditor.

Thanks,
Amira Qureshi
Senior Security Engineer
TekLink Systems
security@teklink.com
(415) 555-0183

--
Attachment stubs requested: hsm_attestation_summary.pdf, rotation_log_sample.csv, operator_access_matrix.csv, transit_config.txt

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Mar 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM PDT
Subject: Fwd: TekLink: SIG / CAIQ follow-up - KMS & HSM artifacts

Irene / Dylan —

TekLink (external) asked for a concise artifact bundle for their SIG/CAIQ review. Can you each take the items below? I've CC'd Marissa for the narrative/cover note. Please keep production copies redacted as discussed (no real customer IDs, mask IPs). We need a deliverable by EOD Fri Mar 12.

Action items:
- Irene: pull the HSM attestation / vendor statement (latest) and a short one-paragraph summary of the attestation scope. Attach as "20260310_hsm_attestation_summary.pdf". Owner: @irene.
- Dylan: export rotation events for tenant-key rotations for the last 6 months. CSV should include: rotation_time (UTC), rotation_type (scheduled/ emergency/expiration), initiating_principal (redact full email), and key_identifier (redact full UUID to first 8 chars). Save as "rotation_log_2025-09_to_2026-03.csv". Owner: @dylan.
- Marissa: draft a 1-page cover note that maps these artifacts to the SIG/CAIQ control IDs and includes the transit encryption summary. Include a snippet file "transit_tls_config_snippet.txt" and an operator mapping CSV "operator_access_matrix_20260310.csv". Owner: @marissa.

Notes: keep PII and tenant identifiers redacted. If any of these are not shareable, flag immediately and we'll substitute a statement-of-practices or an auditor contact.

Thanks folks — please confirm ownership and ETA inline.

-Vanessa
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, Mar 10, 2026 at 12:20 PM PDT
Subject: Re: Fwd: TekLink: SIG / CAIQ follow-up - KMS & HSM artifacts

On Tue, Mar 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene / Dylan —
> 
> TekLink (external) asked for a concise artifact bundle for their SIG/CAIQ review.

Confirmed — I'll pull the HSM attestation and vendor letter. The attestation we have from our HSM vendor (HSMCo) is a standard annual attestation (covers FIPS 140-3 level, physical custody controls, and operator separation of duties). I'll redact customer names; the attestation will be the vendor-signed PDF plus a one-paragraph scope note.

ETA: I can have the attestation + scope note by tomorrow EOD (Wed 03/11).

Also, quick question for @dylan: when you export rotation events, do you want us to also include the operator change logs (authorization approvals) or just the rotation event entries? TekLink asked for operator ids; we should avoid full emails.

-Irene
Sr. Security Engineer, Cryptography & Key Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachments to include in final bundle (I will drop into shared folder):
- 20260310_hsm_attestation_summary.pdf (vendor attestation, redacted)
- attestation_scope_note.txt

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Amira Qureshi <amira@teklink.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, Mar 12, 2026 at 03:45 PM PDT
Subject: Re: TekLink: SIG / CAIQ follow-up - KMS & HSM artifacts

Amira —

Thanks for the patience. Per your request, attached is a redacted evidence bundle that maps to the SIG/CAIQ encryption and KMS controls. We've provided redacted artifacts and a short cover note to explain scope and redaction policy.

Included items (files attached / shared link):
- 20260310_hsm_attestation_summary.pdf — vendor attestation (redacted for tenant names; includes statement of HSM scope and compliance posture)
- rotation_log_2025-09_to_2026-03.csv — rotation events for scheduled and emergency rotations (initiating_principal values redacted to role: "key-ops-1", "key-ops-2")
- operator_access_matrix_20260310.csv — operator role matrix (high-level, no personal emails)
- transit_tls_config_snippet.txt — excerpt showing TLS minimum ciphers and cert rotation cadence (edge -> runtime)

We also uploaded the same set to a restricted Drive folder for TekLink: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Xk-teklink-kms-evidence (access request required). If you prefer a signed auditor attestation instead of the rotation CSV, we can coordinate a short engagement with our auditor (contact included below).

A few important notes:
- All customer-identifying information has been redacted per our data sharing policy (redaction log attached in the Drive).
- Operator identities in the CSV are role-mapped to preserve auditability without exposing PII.
- HSM attestation is vendor-signed (HSMCo). If you need the full vendor package under an NDA, let us know and we can route that through legal.

Would you like a brief 30-minute call tomorrow to walk through the artifacts with your auditor? We can have Irene and Dylan join to answer technical questions.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

--
Attachment stubs: 20260310_hsm_attestation_summary.pdf (PDF, redacted), rotation_log_2025-09_to_2026-03.csv (CSV, redacted), operator_access_matrix_20260310.csv (CSV), transit_tls_config_snippet.txt (TXT)
